opening.argument: The speaker presents a step-by-step BTCC platform tutorial, showing how to create an account, deposit cryptocurrency, and use the futures trading interface. The partnership and referral offer are explicit: viewers are invited to sign up through the speaker's link for up to $11,000 in bonuses and a trading-fee discount. But the walkthrough also distinguishes practice with virtual funds from live trading and warns that crypto is risky and an investment may be lost. Those facts support a promotional review and operational demonstration, not a finding that the bonus or exchange is deceptive. The record establishes the signup and deposit instructions; it does not establish deception or any viewer's outcome.

citations.quote: in this video, I'm going to show you exactly how to use this platform.
when you sign up using my link down below in the description, you can get up to $11,000 in new user signup bonuses plus up to a 70% discount on your trading fees
make sure you send this amount of USDT or whatever coin you chose on this network to that address
